content.text:
Exclusive—SK Hynix’s Solidigm weighs IPO that could value the unit at up to $150 billion, sources say: Reuters, citing three people familiar with the matter, reported a possible IPO as early as the following year, a valuation of up to $150 billion and possible proceeds of $15 billion. It said Solidigm held bank pitch meetings that week, while the deal’s size and timing remained preliminary and could change. The article also reported SK hynix’s statement that no specific plans were confirmed. (time=2026-09-25 12:47 PM (page timezone not stated); cutoff=UNKNOWN).
